text: Have you come up determined not to deal?” “Not exactly.” “Not exactly? In that case let’s be starting.” She lingered to admire the motor, which was new and a fairer creature than the vermilion giant that had borne Aunt Juley to her doom three years before. “Presumably it’s very beautiful,” she said. “How do you like it, Crane?” “Come, let’s be starting,” repeated her host. “How on earth did you know that my chauffeur was called Crane?” “Why, I know Crane: I’ve been for a drive with Evie once.
